label: Monday, November 2, 2026 · Apple test-day edition
intro: Good morning. It's Monday, November 2nd. Here's your Read Daily brief.

items.title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq recover from bruising sell-off as oil prices fall
items.take: Stocks opened higher Monday as tech catches its breath after October's AI sell-off, with the Dow up 0.7% and the Nasdaq up 0.7% in morning trade. Anthropic filed an amended S-1 Monday morning, a fresh look at the filing just ahead of a debut expected as soon as this month.

items.title: Apple's new CEO faces earnings test as rising chip costs cloud outlook
items.take: Apple reports after the bell tonight, the first quarter under new CEO John Ternus. Consensus looks for about $2 of EPS on roughly $113.4B of revenue, but the watch items are rising memory-chip costs, holiday guidance, and iPhone Duo demand.

items.title: Cracks in the A.I. Borrowing Binge
items.take: Big Tech's AI spending is squeezing cash flow and pushing companies toward more borrowing and stock sales, and Wall Street is hunting for a catalyst to quiet the bubble chatter. A lot rides on Anthropic's trading debut, and the filing's own language about catastrophic risk is drawing attention.

items.title: Wall Street futures rise as AI stocks catch their breath; midterms in focus
items.take: After a week of negative AI sentiment, Reuters notes OpenAI has reportedly cut $10B from its latest funding-round target and Blackstone has told investors Anthropic may not secure an investment-grade rating after its IPO. Futures still rose Monday with the midterms in focus.

items.title: Apple Earnings, Midterms, Jobs Data Put Markets To The Test: 3 Charts To Watch This Week
items.take: Three tests decide whether last week's AI sell-off was a blip: Apple tonight, the midterms Tuesday (CNBC has Democrats expected to take the House, the Senate still uncertain), and Friday's October jobs report. The jobs print also shapes whether slowing hiring keeps a December Fed rate hike on the table.

items.title: Democratic Dust-up Puts Must-Win Seat at Risk
items.take: Today's featured listen from the rotation, ahead of tomorrow's midterms: the Journal's daily show on a Democratic intraparty fight that has put a must-win Senate seat at risk, the first market-relevant data point of election week.
